subject: [PATCH 21/22] mm/khugepaged: base the recommended min_free_kbytes on common memory

2026-11-14.patch_summary: This patch adjusts the calculation for recommended min_free_kbytes in the khugepaged module to reserve memory only on nodes that are marked as N_MEMORY_COMMON, which represents common memory. This change helps THP allocations avoid fragmentation by reserving two pageblocks per populated zone on these nodes. The recommendation remains unchanged for all other nodes with memory.
